_comment: Expected violations of the formal model, variant fix with the K fixes of the fixed list switched on (= the code of the integration branch). xfail = known counterexample, not fixed yet: CI is red when it DISAPPEARS (flip it) and when anything NOT listed appears. accepted = by design or a model artifact. K numbers are the counterexamples K1-K10 of REPORT.ru.md (K = Cyrillic К). See README.md for flipping.

LEAK:begin-instant.note: by design: the instant between the STARTING write and guard(), no I/O wait in between

LEAK:recovery-window.note: by design: power cut / crash until the recovery guard step

LEAK:after-the-owner-stop.note: by design: the owner's Stop releases the guard; kernel rebuilt from the UCI primary

TRANSITION:ROLLBACK-ONTO-DEAD-PRIMARY:cr.note: K6 by design: rollback onto a dead primary after a crash

TRANSITION:ROLLBACK-ONTO-DEAD-PRIMARY:po.note: K6 by design: rollback onto a dead primary after a power cut

LIVENESS:stop-primary-down.note: K8 by design: Stop with a dead primary leaves the traffic on the reserve under VPN-only

LIVENESS:stop-primary-up.note: K7: after failures ROLLBACK-GIVEN-UP needs the operator

EF-START.note: K7: ROLLBACK-GIVEN-UP is left only by the operator

INCONSISTENT.note: K10: only with failures after a power cut (failed kernel reload in the rollback); possibly a model artifact
